scripts.test:mobile:p0: pnpm --filter @babyloop/mobile exec jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/ui/mobile-layout.test.ts src/features/auth/auth-api.test.ts src/features/security/security-model.test.ts src/features/sell/sell-form-model.test.ts src/features/sell/image-upload-model.test.ts src/features/child/child-reminders-api.test.ts src/features/child/child-reminders-model.test.ts src/features/notifications/notifications-api.test.ts src/features/notifications/notifications-model.test.ts src/features/auth/auth-sessions-api.test.ts src/features/security/mobile-session-model.test.ts src/features/security/mobile-login-approval-model.test.ts src/features/messages/messages-realtime-model.test.ts

scripts.validate: pnpm preflight && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.e2e:web:full-flow:guarded: mkdir -p .e2e-results && WEB_E2E_FULL_FLOW=1 WEB_E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 WEB_E2E_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000 pnpm --filter @babyloop/web exec playwright test --reporter=json --workers=1 > .e2e-results/web-full-flow.json && node scripts/assert-playwright-no-skips.mjs .e2e-results/web-full-flow.json
scripts.e2e:backoffice:guarded: mkdir -p .e2e-results && BACKOFFICE_E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @babyloop/backoffice exec playwright test --reporter=json --workers=1 > .e2e-results/backoffice.json && node scripts/assert-playwright-no-skips.mjs .e2e-results/backoffice.json
scripts.test:api:security: node scripts/run-api-test-bundle.mjs security && pnpm security:auth-leaks && pnpm security:image-storage && pnpm security:upload-storage-boundary && pnpm security:image-authenticity && pnpm security:cross-listing-duplicates && pnpm security:notification-delivery-log && pnpm security:child-reminder-delivery && pnpm security:saved-search-delivery && pnpm security:notification-ops-preview && pnpm security:notification-delivery-transitions && pnpm security:notification-push-readiness
scripts.test:web:seo: pnpm --filter @babyloop/web exec vitest run src/lib/seo.test.ts src/app/robots.test.ts src/app/sitemap.test.ts
scripts.release:mobile:p0: pnpm security:mobile-auth && pnpm security:mobile-notifications && pnpm test:mobile:p0 && pnpm --filter @babyloop/mobile typecheck
